description: Jitsi JWT auth + attendance monitoring. Fixes JWT generation in JitsiService, injects JWT into meeting-room view, adds the attendance endpoint, and wires Jitsi IFrame API postMessage events to it. Independent of FEAT-003/004 but depends on FEAT-001 (new columns).
steps: Modify `app/Services/JitsiService.php` generateJWT() method. Fix three bugs: (1) change `'aud' => $this->appId` to `'aud' => 'jitsi'`; (2) add `'sub' => $this->domain` to the payload root; (3) change `'moderator' => $isModerator ? 'true' : 'false'` to `'moderator' => (bool) $isModerator` in the context.user block. Also change constructor to read `JITSI_USE_JWT` env var using `config()` — add a `config/jitsi.php` or just use `env('JITSI_USE_JWT', false)` (existing pattern). The final JWT payload must match exactly: { context: { user: { name, email, moderator: bool } }, aud: 'jitsi', iss: JITSI_APP_ID, sub: JITSI_DOMAIN, room: roomName, exp: now+3600 }.
Add `JITSI_USE_JWT=true` to `.env` file (append to the JITSI block).

Modify `app/Http/Controllers/BookingController.php` meetingRoom() method: (a) change the entry window from `$minutesUntilStart <= 15` to `$minutesUntilStart <= 5` and update the error message copy; (b) after the access check, generate a JWT token: `$jitsiService = app(\App\Services\JitsiService::class); $isModerator = ($user->id === $booking->tutor_id); $jwtToken = $jitsiService->getSignedToken($booking->meeting_room, $user->name, $isModerator, ['email' => $user->email]);` — add a `getSignedToken()` method to JitsiService that always calls generateJWT() regardless of JITSI_USE_JWT flag (for server-side generation); (c) pass `$jwtToken` to the view.

Add `getSignedToken(string $roomName, string $displayName, bool $isModerator, array $options = []): string` method to `app/Services/JitsiService.php`. It calls generateJWT() directly and returns the token string.

Modify `resources/views/pages/bookings/meeting-room.blade.php`: (a) Add `const jwtToken = '{{ $jwtToken ?? '' }}';` in the JS block; (b) In the JitsiMeetExternalAPI options object, add `jwt: jwtToken` at the top level (alongside `roomName`, `width`, etc.); (c) Wire attendance events: inside the `api.addEventListener('videoConferenceJoined', ...)` callback, call `pingAttendance('joined')` using the participant's own code; (d) wire `api.addEventListener('participantLeft', ...)` to call `pingAttendance('left')`; (e) Define `function pingAttendance(event) { fetch('/bookings/{{ $booking->uuid }}/attendance', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'X-CSRF-TOKEN': document.querySelector('meta[name=csrf-token]').content, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ event: event, code: sessionCode }) }); }` — the `sessionCode` variable already exists in the view; (f) Add a teaching timer `<div id='teach-timer' style='display:none;'>` in the session-header bar; start it when both parties are connected (track participant count ≥ 2 via `participantJoined` events); (g) Add a 'Session Ending Soon' banner that appears when `Date.now() > scheduledEndMs - 5*60*1000` where `scheduledEndMs = {{ $booking->scheduledEndAt()->timestamp * 1000 }}` — check every 30s with `setInterval`.

Add `POST /bookings/{booking:uuid}/attendance` route to `routes/web.php` inside the auth middleware group: `Route::post('/bookings/{booking:uuid}/attendance', [BookingController::class, 'recordAttendance'])->name('bookings.attendance');`

Add `recordAttendance(Request $request, Booking $booking)` method to `app/Http/Controllers/BookingController.php`. Logic: validate `event` (in:joined,left) and `code` (string). Determine role: if `$request->code === $booking->session_code_tutor` → tutor; elseif `$request->code === $booking->session_code_student` → student; else return 403. On 'joined': if tutor, set `tutor_joined_at = now()`, `tutor_joined = true`; if student, set `student_joined_at = now()`, `student_joined = true`. After setting, if both `tutor_joined_at` and `student_joined_at` are set and `actual_start_at` is null, set `actual_start_at = now()`. On 'left': set `actual_end_at = now()`. Return `response()->json(['status' => 'ok'])`.
acceptance_criteria: Running `php artisan route:list | Select-String 'attendance'` shows the attendance route
BookingController::meetingRoom() rejects access >5 min before session (not >15 min)
JitsiService::generateJWT() produces a JWT with aud='jitsi', sub=JITSI_DOMAIN, and moderator as boolean
The meeting-room view includes `jwt: jwtToken` in the Jitsi options object
The pingAttendance() JS function is present in meeting-room.blade.php
The teaching timer div (#teach-timer) is present in meeting-room.blade.php
POST to /bookings/{uuid}/attendance with event=joined and valid code updates tutor_joined_at or student_joined_at
verification: php artisan config:clear && php artisan view:clear
